preregistration.mechanism: MMP: release m_i = (1 - pibar) q_i^0 + pibar q_i^1 (designer 1 proposal sha256 2b7273ae...)
preregistration.reference: exact SEX-blind posterior eta (a perfect U0); budgets cap = (acc 0.010, NLL 0.010, summed Brier 0.005) and cap_plus_headroom = (0.016, 0.020, 0.009)
preregistration.strongest_baseline_analogue: exact global frontier: minimum pair Bayes AUC over all calibrated partition pairs feasible at the budget (weakly dominates every deterministic release in Bayes terms)

expected.identities: In all four finite laws and both tasks: Brier(m) - Brier(eta) equals E[(pi - pibar)^2 ||q^1 - q^0||^2] exactly; NLL excess equals E KL(eta || m) and is <= I(S; X).
expected.L_NEG: MMP releases are constant (no task information); MMP infeasible at both budgets; the global frontier at the cap stays at pair AUC >= 0.70 (required disclosure); twin pair AUC = AUC*(S; X) (about 0.81).
expected.L_PROXY: MMP pair AUC = 1/2 exactly; MMP feasible at the cap (no decision changes); global frontier at the cap = 1/2; local, S12 and S21 designs also reach 1/2 (no joint component needed); twin pair AUC about 0.77.
expected.L_PROXY_FLIP: MMP view still has pair AUC 1/2 but MMP fails the strict-cap accuracy clause (decision changes); the global frontier at the cap stays above 1/2.
expected.L_MIXED: MMP pair AUC = AUC*(S; h) = 0.65 exactly (residual through the task-relevant proxy); MMP feasible at the cap; twin pair AUC > 0.65; global frontier at the cap within 0.02 of 0.65 (at least 0.63).
expected.L_NOPROXY: No pure proxy: MMP separates every cell, so its pair Bayes AUC equals the twin's (= AUC*(S; X)); MMP gives no Bayes-level reduction here (an honest limit, not a failure of the code).
expected.L_XOR: Coalition required disclosure: MMP single-recipient AUCs are 1/2 but its pair AUC equals AUC*(S; X) (the tasks jointly need a SEX-revealing combination); no release feasible at the cap lowers the pair below 0.80.
expected.subgroup: Within-SEX occupation Brier increases are reported for every law; in L_CONT laws (pibar = 0.47) the women's increase is expected to exceed the men's (verifier M5, constant-gap approximation); a reversal is reported as such.
expected.masking_comparison: In L_CONT laws a critic-style local linear eraser on each recipient's own wire, at the same summed-Brier price as MMP per task, lowers single-recipient fitted AUCs more than the pair AUC relative to the twin (masking signature); MMP's pair AUC is below the eraser's pair AUC (deletion beats masking at equal price). If not, MMP section 3.6 is not supported in that law.
expected.L_CONT_PROXY: Bayes: MMP pair AUC (P(S | H, E, A)) below the twin (AUC*(S; X)). Fitted 7-reader slate, mean over 3 replications: MMP pair AUC below the twin by >= 0.005.
expected.L_CONT_NOPROXY: Bayes: MMP equals the twin (both functions of the same fields; no merging). Fitted: MMP pair AUC below the twin by >= 0.005 (the learnability part of the rationale). If not, that part is not supported in this law and any real-data benefit would have to come from genuine merging.
expected.demonstrations: D1 decision-preserving bound, D2 true labels not a floor, D3 fitted below Bayes: all checks pass.

what_would_contradict_the_rationale: Brier identity or NLL bound fails anywhere
MMP feasible in L_NEG, or MMP pair AUC not 1/2 in L_PROXY, or not 0.65 in L_MIXED
MMP far (> 0.02) above the global frontier at its own feasible budget in L_PROXY or L_MIXED
In L_CONT_NOPROXY the fitted pair AUC of MMP is not below the twin by >= 0.005
In an L_CONT law MMP's fitted pair AUC is not below the matched-price local eraser's
preregistration.added_before_first_run_per_selection_con: L_NOPROXY, L_XOR, the matched-price local linear eraser, subgroup and w* reporting (verifier fixes (i), (ii), (iv); SELECTION_DECISION.md)
